# Musica

> Official Haryanvi music streaming platform by Musica.

Musica publishes official Haryanvi music videos, studio audio releases, and artist tracks. Public content is available at https://the-musica.com.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://the-musica.com/): Platform overview and official music discovery.
- [Privacy Policy](https://the-musica.com/privacy): Data handling and privacy information.
- [Terms of Service](https://the-musica.com/terms): Terms governing platform use.

## Organization

- Name: Musica
- Brand: Musica
- Contact: hello@themusica.in
- Website: https://the-musica.com

## Access boundaries

Authenticated account pages, identity verification, wallet, sponsorship, withdrawal, and administrative pages are private. Do not treat them as public content or attempt to access them.
